leaf_scarf.name: Leaf Scarf
leaf_scarf.desc: A soft scarf made from fresh leaves and a tiny flower. Simple, cozy, and perfect for little adventures.

golden_crest_crown.name: Golden Crest Crown
golden_crest_crown.desc: A regal crown fit for a brave little explorer. Shines with the spirit of new adventures.

explorer_hat.name: Explorer Hat
explorer_hat.desc: A trusty hat with trail goggles and a meadow feather. Ready for any path.

blue_scarf.name: Blue Scarf
blue_scarf.desc: A hand-knitted scarf the colour of a clear morning sky.

tiny_crown.name: Tiny Crown
tiny_crown.desc: A little crown that sits at a jaunty angle. Royalty, but make it casual.

butterfly_clip.name: Butterfly Clip
butterfly_clip.desc: A sunny butterfly that likes to ride along on walks.

red_backpack.name: Red Backpack
red_backpack.desc: Room for snacks, pebbles, and one very important leaf.

explorer_pack.name: Explorer Pack
explorer_pack.desc: A leather pack with a rolled bedroll on top, for long journeys.

meadow_nest.name: Meadow Nest
meadow_nest.desc: A mossy nest woven with daisies. Your Evochi naps best here.

nest_bed.name: Nest Bed
nest_bed.desc: A simple straw bed. Warm, soft, and smells like sunshine.

explorer_lantern.name: Explorer Lantern
explorer_lantern.desc: A warm lantern that keeps the nest cozy after sunset.

sunlit_flower.name: Sunlit Flower
sunlit_flower.desc: A cheerful daisy cluster that turns to face the sun.

berry_snack.name: Berry Snack
berry_snack.desc: A handful of sweet meadow berries. Restores 4 vitality.

healing_herb.name: Healing Herb
healing_herb.desc: A soothing herb bundle. Restores 10 vitality (12h cooldown).
